summary: NICE Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing press releases and presentations about its upcoming NiCE World 2026 conference and product announcements. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of operational updates and investor event information. It does not involve any M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction. The content is purely promotional for the company's CX AI platform and annual customer event. No deal terms, financial thresholds, board-level actions, or structural changes are mentioned. Therefore, this filing is classified as a non-special situation.
